snippet.title: Fail Hard - Teaser
snippet.description:
Teaser trailer for Fail Hard 
A new download title that's out now.

Download for Android from Play store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fingersoft.failhard

Step in to the biker boots of the world most resilient wannabe stuntman. Jump and fall in several locations while performing the most dangerous and exciting stunts.
Fail Hard is being made by Viima Games and published by Fingersoft. 

Check out our pages http://www.viimagames.com/ 
Like us in Facebook https://www.facebook.com/ViimaGamesOy 
or follow us in Twitter https://twitter.com/ViimaGames

More about Fingersoft http://www.fingersoft.net/.
